reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: syncRoles is an active Express route (src/index.ts:68), not dead code. Gate 2: no trust_assumptions map in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json; entry point is the bearer-authenticated REST API with no TRUSTED/SEMI_TRUSTED override. Gate 3: src/api/rolesSync.ts is explicitly in scope. Spec deviation is confirmed — rolesSync.ts:L25-35 omits .is('deleted_at', null), inconsistent with rolesSyncAll.ts:L16-19 and members.ts:L18. An attacker can trigger this via POST /api/roles/sync with the discord_uid of a soft-deleted member, causing the deactivated member to have Discord roles (including 'verified') re-applied; however, exploitation requires a valid API_AUTH_TOKEN bearer secret, making the attack path conditional on credential compromise or insider access. Medium severity retained: no client_diversity cap applies and authenticated-only exploitability limits impact to insider/compromised-token scenarios.
